idea-plugin.name: Phantom Icon Pack
idea-plugin.description: Colored file and folder icons by name and extension, drawn from the Material Icon Theme by Philipp Kief (MIT). Java classes show a cup by kind (full, half-full or empty for a class, an abstract class or an interface; dots, lines or ! for an enum, a record or an exception; @ for an annotation). Kotlin classes show Material icons told apart by shape, with the Kotlin mark: class, abstract class, interface, enum, annotation, data class, object. A Java file, and a Kotlin file of one class, shows its class's kind also as a file (Project view, navigation bar, editor tabs); other Kotlin files show the Kotlin logo, a Java file without a class the Java cup. Source, test and resource roots get their own folder colors. Only the icons of files on screen are loaded. Turn the plugin off to get the platform icons back.
